mapper.select: SELECT b.id FROM basecamp b WHERE b.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'CLOSED', 'CONFIRMED') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_member bm WHERE bm.basecamp_id = b.id AND bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND bm.status = 'ACTIVE') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_application a WHERE a.basecamp_id = b.id AND a.applicant_id = #{memberId} AND a.status = 'PENDING')) ORDER BY b.id
